0.q: The OX lines showed lower Put concentration than the wild type under control, salt stress and H2O2 stress conditions. However, under control and stress conditions, Spd and Spm increased in the OX lines. These results showed that overexpressed BvM14-SAMS2 greatly influenced polyamine metabolism.

1.q: These results show that BvM14-SAMDC regulates salt stress tolerance by improving antioxidant activity and reducing ROS production.

2.q: Six main proteins (GOX, PrxR, Trx, APX, DHAR3, and MDHAR) of the antioxidant enzymes system changed most significantly in the ROS scavenging system under salt stress.

3.q: DHAR recycles ascorbic acid (AsA), which is then oxidized to form MDHAR... MDHAR accompanies APX and scavenges H2O2 in the mitochondria and peroxisome.

4.q: MDHAR accompanies APX and scavenges H2O2 in the mitochondria and peroxisome.

5.q: DHAR recycles ascorbic acid (AsA), which is then oxidized to form MDHAR. MDHAR is further converted to dehydroascorbate (DHA).

6.q: The Trx and PrxR enzyme activities in BvM14-PrxR gene OX lines and BvM14-Trx gene OX lines were significantly higher by 1.5-fold and 1.3-fold than WT under salt stress, respectively.
